reader.requirement: OPEN EXTEND of an unavailable OPTIONAL report file must create the file (as OPEN OUTPUT + CLOSE, then the EXTEND), OPEN OUTPUT must create the file, and a newly created file must contain no data records.

edition-consulted.switches: DialectBehavior.FileSharingFacility: Table 19 arbitration and buffered-record release; off at 85
DialectBehavior.CloseWithLockLocksFileConnector: what CLOSE WITH LOCK locks (physical file at 85)

reader.edition-search: grep Edition|DialectBehavior in FileRegistry.cs, FileConnector.cs, SequentialConnector.cs; the creation arms of SequentialConnector.OpenCore (CreateNew for absent, Create for OUTPUT, Append for EXTEND) have no edition test
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no for this rule: op14 printed identically at 85 and 2023
reader.witnesses-cover: part: g85_f19_05 checks only the 05 then 00 statuses; it never reads the created file back to show it holds no records, nor that OUTPUT empties a file holding records

probes.printed: EXTEND ABSENT OPTIONAL 05; CLOSE 00; read back 0 chars; EXTEND PRESENT 00; after one report 2 chars [PP]; after a second EXTEND report 4 chars [PPPP]; Q after OUTPUT report 4 chars, then OPEN OUTPUT 00 and read back 0 chars
probes.expected: created empty (05 per §1985:VII.1.3.5), EXTEND appends, OUTPUT leaves no data records

probes.printed: EXTEND ABSENT NONOPT 35 (USE RB entered); EXTEND ABSENT OPT 05
probes.expected: non-optional absent EXTEND unsuccessful (Table 1); optional created

citations.check: OK  §1985:XIII.4.5.4 GR14  (4.5.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR14
OK  §1985:VII.1.3.5  (1.3.5 I-O Status)  the text is in the clause; it lies in GRL2.1c

reader.notes: SequentialConnector.OpenCore's EXTEND arm opens an absent OPTIONAL file with FileMode.CreateNew and returns 05; the OUTPUT arm uses Create (truncate) or CreateNew. The edition consults on the path (sharing facility, CLOSE WITH LOCK) do not touch the creation outcome. Classes a, d, f do not reach the rule.

refuter.evidence: refute-1985-152/rop14.cob (--std 85): one OPEN EXTEND naming two unavailable OPTIONAL report files gave 05 05; after CLOSE each opened INPUT with 00 (present) and held 0 records; a second OPEN EXTEND gave 00 00 and one GENERATE each left 2 records [A][A] and [B][B] (appended after the created empty file); OPEN OUTPUT of the second with nothing generated, then CLOSE, left 0 records. rop16.cob: OPEN EXTEND of an OPTIONAL file whose directory does not exist answered 30 (the creation cannot succeed; GR14 binds only a successful OPEN). cite.py: OK  §1985:XIII.4.5.4 GR14  (4.5.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR14.
